description.value:
Your foes must recognize your authority or be punished for their insolence. Creatures that rank below you in a shared hierarchical organization treat the result of their Will save as one degree of success worse.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Frightened]{Frightened 1}.

Failure The target is frightened 1. On its next turn, it must Stride in your direction (stopping if its movement brings it adjacent to you), then Drop Prone before using actions to do anything else. The target can't use hostile actions against you for the spell's duration. If you use a hostile action against the target, the spell ends.

Critical Failure As failure, but hostility doesn't end the effect.

Heightened (8th) You can target up to 5 creatures.

Heightened (10th) You can target up to 10 creatures.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Cheliax, Infernal Inheritance
